headline: Base Turnover Intensifies on Multiple Fronts
war_summary: Since the 21:00 edition the tempo of base exchanges has sharpened across the theater. Fishermans Row remains the most volatile sector, recording ten ownership changes in the past six hours and twenty in the day, with Colonial and Warden casualties holding near 280 and 320 per hour respectively. Linn Mercy continues its frenetic pace, adding three fresh captures in six hours and thirty‑two total, pushing both sides’ loss rates above 250 per hour. New pressure persists at Lykos Isle, where two flips occurred in the last two hours and seven total today, and at Stlican Shelf, which logged two captures in six hours. Dead Lands, previously cooling, has risen to seven daily captures with Warden losses near 1,600 per hour. Endless Shore’s intense fighting has not abated; eleven captures were recorded today, the latest at 09:20. Godcrofts, Kings Cage, Oarbreaker and Stonecradle show modest activity but no fresh two‑hour events. Meanwhile, rear‑area hexes such as Clahstra, Loch Mor and Weathered Expanse exhibit sharply accelerating casualty curves without any base turnover, indicating heavy attrition without territorial change.
